title: Single-cell profiling of DNA methylation in autism spectrum disorder prefrontal cortex reveals distinct regulatory and aging signatures.
abstract: snmCT-seq profiling of DNA methylation and transcript levels from >60,000 prefrontal cortex nuclei across 49 donors. Over 30,000 ASD differentially methylated regions, enriched in promoters and cell-type-specific regulatory elements across the lifespan. Methylation changes were uncorrelated with transcript levels and small relative to age effects; age-DMRs concentrated in excitatory neurons; neuron projection development flagged as a perturbed process.
